Dead Tiamat

Original: https://shrouded-lands.fandom.com/wiki/Dead_Tiamat

History

Features

*The descendants of those reshaped by Tiamat’s blood are the dragonblooded. *Bone shards chewed by Tiamat are a ritual currency.

Heads of Tiamat

*According to rumour, the foundations of Skullreach are the skull of Tiamat’s blue head. *Likewise, some say the heat of the Burning Lands is due to the red dragon’s skull - perhaps Tiamat’s - at the heart of Blackhorn’s Maze (39.32). *Tiamat’s black head fell on what is now the Stolen Hills (24.11), corrupting the land. The head is no longer there; what happened to it is disputed. *A merchant in the Goblin Markets claims to have Tiamat’s shrunken white head in a sack.

Worshippers

*Kolfrosta, in The Temple of the Dead God (03.13) *Tiamat Reborn and his followers attempt to achieve his apotheosis as he believes himself to be a reincarnation of Tiamat. They occupy the Castle with Five Gates (26.16.02). *A band of cultists have established themselves in some caves in the Grey Mountains (14.02). *The Tiamatan Revival is another group that reveres Tiamat. Splitters! *John Luciferus, a mad lictor of the Tiamat Cult, wrote the Book of Not Being Boiled in Fire before being burned at the stake. *A cult in Cragsend (04.06) is led by a cleric-turned-sorcerer who worships a dragon, but not Tiamat.
